title: Basic Calculator

monster.name: Math Drake
monster.title: Solver of Nested Signed Expressions
monster.defeatQuote: Stack saved intermediate signs across nested parentheses!

description: Given a string `s` representing a valid expression with `+`, `-`, non-negative integers, and parentheses `(`, `)`, implement a basic calculator to evaluate it.
solutionCode:
def calculateExpression(s: str) -> int:
    stack = []
    res = 0
    num = 0
    sign = 1
    for ch in s:
        if ch.isdigit():
            num = num * 10 + int(ch)
        elif ch in '+-':
            res += sign * num
            num = 0
            sign = 1 if ch == '+' else -1
        elif ch == '(':
            stack.append(res)
            stack.append(sign)
            res = 0
            sign = 1
        elif ch == ')':
            res += sign * num
            num = 0
            res *= stack.pop()
            res += stack.pop()
    res += sign * num
    return res
hints: Maintain running result and current sign. On '(', push result and sign; on ')', pop and combine.

    num = 0
    sign = 1
    for ch in s:
        if ch.isdigit():

        elif ch in '+-':
            res += sign * num
            num = 0
            sign = 1 if ch == '+' else -1
        elif ch == '(':
            stack.append(res)
            stack.append(sign)
            res = 0
            sign = 1
        elif ch == ')':
            res += sign * num
            num = 0
            res *= stack.pop()
            res += stack.pop()
    res += sign * num
    return res
